catalog.summary: Records as stacked label and value items.

patternAbsent.reason: The Authoring Practices publish no pattern for a list of records. The set is list's role=list, read 2026-09-24, and every interactive part is a native element or a borrowed pattern below.

borrowed.more: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/ — role button; aria-expanded true while the content is visible; aria-controls names the content; Enter and Space toggle
borrowed.sort: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/ — role button with aria-haspopup menu and aria-expanded; Enter, Space and ArrowDown open on the first item, ArrowUp on the last; the menu's own keys are menu's

roleReason: The root holds the header, the list and the footer. The set is the list, named by label; a role on the root would name the same set twice.

anatomy.root: div[data-ui=data-list], the query container slotted-data-list; carries data-loading and aria-busy while rows are refreshed
anatomy.header: div above the list: select-all, count and sort, in that order
anatomy.select-all: span holding checkbox's DOM; present in selectionMode multiple
anatomy.count: output with aria-live polite: messages.count without a selection, messages.selectedCount with one
anatomy.sort: span holding button's DOM, the menu's trigger; carries data-direction for the first key; present when a column is sortable
anatomy.selection: span in list-item's start holding the record's checkbox
anatomy.media: span in list-item's start holding renderMedia or ng-template[slDataListMedia]
anatomy.title: a with href, button with activatable, span otherwise; inside list-item's label; its ::after covers the item
anatomy.fields: dl of the record's fields, a child of list-item's content placed from the text column to the row's end (from the start edge below list-item's 22rem)
anatomy.field: div holding one pair, the grouping HTML allows inside a dl
anatomy.field-value: dd, drawn by the column's cell template with { column, row, value, text }
anatomy.field-empty: span in an empty field-value: a drawn rule and messages.empty, visually hidden
anatomy.more: button after fields, in the same grid placement, toggling the fields past fields; aria-expanded, aria-controls the dl
anatomy.trailing: span in list-item's end holding the trailing column's value
anatomy.empty: div holding result-state: empty, no-results or error
anatomy.loader: div holding skeleton's region and skeletonRows skeleton records
anatomy.footer: div under the list: load-more, and the consumer's own footer content
anatomy.load-more: span holding button's DOM; present with hasMore

data.rows: the consumer's array, read every render and never mutated
data.rowKey: a field name or a function of the row; every state model names rows by it
data.columns: GridColumn<Row>[] of @slotted/core/grid, the type data-grid, column-manager and saved-views read
data.columnState: Partial<GridColumnState>, read for order and hidden; widths and pins mean nothing in a list
data.query: GridQuery of @slotted/core/grid: sort, filter, search, page, group
data.mode: client applies the query with applyQuery; server draws the rows it is given and reads totalCount. Resolved to server when totalCount is given, client otherwise.
data.reason: The item needs the columns to place a value and the sort menu needs them to name a key, so the family reads a column model; table's rows are the consumer's children and hold none. The model is data-grid's so one query drives a grid and a list.

columns.title: the column named by title; else the first visible column with rowHeader true; else the first visible data column
columns.subtitle: the column named by subtitle, drawn in list-item's description; none by default
columns.trailing: the column named by trailing, drawn in list-item's end; none by default
columns.actions: every visible column of kind actions, drawn in list-item's actions in declared order
columns.fields: the remaining visible columns: numbered priority ascending, ties in declared order, then those without a priority in declared order — the order columnsOutOfSpace removes them in, reversed. The first fields appear; the rest appear while the record is expanded.
columns.excluded: a column with popin: false, and a column hidden by columnState, is drawn nowhere — the pop-in leaves it out for the same reason

fields.geometry: grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(9rem, 100%), 1fr)), column-gap space-4, row-gap space-2; the label over the value in font-size-xs and text-muted; under 19rem of fields, the label beside the value in minmax(0, 7.5rem) minmax(0, 1fr)
fields.value: wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere and never truncates
fields.reason: description-list answers its own container at panel thresholds — rows become a stack under 26rem, two columns become one under 34rem — so in a record's body on a phone, 17 to 20rem, it always gives one stacked column, two lines a field. The pop-in's geometry gives two columns of fields from 18rem, and a record reads the same in data-grid's pop-in and in this list. The cost is a third stylesheet drawing a term and a value.

activation.button: activatable makes title a button, which emits activate with { key, row, reason, event }
activation.target: title::after, inset 0 over the li at position relative; selection, more, actions and any control inside a value stand above it at z-index 1
activation.name: the title alone: a dl is not phrasing content and may not sit inside a button, and a link named by every field is a sentence nobody reads twice
activation.cost: the fields' text cannot be selected with a pointer on an activatable record

current.input: current, a row key the application holds; never moved by the family
current.aria: list-item's aria-current on the li: page when the title is a link, true otherwise

sort.control: menu with two radio groups: the column — every sortable visible column and messages.sortNone — and the direction, disabled without a column
sort.writes: choosing a column replaces query.sort with [{ column, direction }], keeping the direction or ascending; choosing a direction rewrites the first key; sortNone empties query.sort
sort.reads: every key; the trigger shows the first key's column and messages.sortMore for the rest
sort.indicator: a mask from --slotted-icon-chevron-down, turned a half turn for ascending, table's own indicator

selection.control: checkbox, in single as in multiple — table's decision, so a reader moving between the two forms meets the same control
selection.range: Shift while pressing a record's checkbox selects every record from the anchor to that one
selection.selectAll: covers every key the query left — every page in client mode, the page in server mode — is indeterminate while some are selected, and states the count in its name
selection.forbiddenReason: listitem does not support it; the record paints data-selected and the checkbox announces it, the division list and table recorded
selection.disabled: disabledKeys: the record is list-item disabled, its checkbox disabled, its activation refused, and nextSelection skips it

expansion.rendered: the fields past fields are not rendered while closed, as data-grid's detail

group.renders: list's section, section-label and section-list per group node; the label is the column's label, the value and the count
group.open: always; a list has no collapsible group row

first.draws: skeletonRows records with the item's anatomy: the title line, the subtitle line when a subtitle column is named, the trailing value when one is named, and fields pairs whose labels are real
first.region: skeleton's region: aria-busy and one polite announcement of messages.loading

loading.refresh: loading over rows already shown: aria-busy and data-loading on the root, the rows dimmed and kept; nothing moves
loading.more: load-more takes button's loading while loading is true over rows
loading.record: loadingKeys: the record is list-item loading — aria-busy, activation refused, width kept
loading.timing: loadingDelay before the skeleton appears and loadingMinDuration it stays, through @slotted/core/loading

states.no-results: the query left nothing; offers messages.clearFilters, which empties query.filter and query.search in one change with reason clear
states.error: error is set; offers messages.retry, which emits retry. Over rows already shown the rows stay and the message stands above them.

focus.removal: when the record holding focus leaves rows, focus goes to the next record's first control, else the previous record's, else empty; never to the body

wiring.aria-label: the consumer's label on the list, required by the types as label or labelledBy
wiring.aria-labelledby: the consumer's labelledBy on the list
wiring.aria-busy: true on the root while loading over rows, and on skeleton's region on the first load
wiring.aria-current: on the current record's li, written by list-item: page with href, true otherwise
wiring.aria-describedby: a checkbox's name comes from messages.selectRow with the title; nothing else is described

keyboard.effect: moves through the header — select-all, sort — and then each record's controls in order: checkbox, title when it is a link or a button, more, actions
moves back under the same rule
follows a link title; activates a button title; toggles more; opens the sort menu
keyboard.focus: stays on the control; the sort menu moves it to the first item

keyboard.effect: toggles a checkbox; activates a button title; toggles more; opens the sort menu
keyboard.focus: stays on the control; the sort menu moves it to the first item

keyboard.effect: on a record's checkbox in multiple, selects from the anchor to that record

keyboardDeparture.deferTo: data-grid for records with a cell cursor, listbox for options
keyboardDeparture.reason: The scope refuses grid navigation, and role=list admits no arrow keys — list's keyboardDeparture. React Aria's GridList binds the arrows by changing the role to grid.
keyboardDeparture.cost: a reader tabbing through twenty records presses Tab once per control; the header's count and the list's name are what a screen reader jumps by

filterControl.composition: <FilterBar fields={…} value={query.filter} onValueChange={(filter) => setQuery({ ...query, filter })} /> above the list

search.composition: <TextField value={query.search} onValueChange={(search) => setQuery({ ...query, search })} />; the list applies query.search

pagination.composition: the footer holds the consumer's pagination bound to query.page; the list applies the page in client mode

reorder.reason: a manual order is undone by a sort; data-grid owns row-handle and @slotted/core/drag

virtualization.reason: the family is for a small set; hasMore and query.page bound the DOM

multiSortEditor.reason: the menu edits the first key; the other keys are read and announced

messagesReason: The words the family says come from the dataList catalog of the language in force, laid over by one messages input. The two whose wording turns on a count, count and selectAll, are plural messages, so each language states its own forms.

literals.--_field-min: 9rem, the pop-in's field floor: two fields side by side from 18rem
literals.--_field-label-inline: 7.5rem, the pop-in's label track when one field fills the row

sort.scope: the query, as data-grid holds it; the request carries change: sort | filter | search | page | group beside the reason

filter.scope: the same query object as sort

disabledReason: The family holds no disabled of its own: a list is read, not operated as one control. A record is disabled by disabledKeys, which list-item paints and every control of the record honours.
